risks.name: Cardiovascular adaptations
risks.summary: Fluid shift and reduced load change heart and vessel function in flight and after landing.

risks.name: Bone loss and fracture
risks.summary: Weight-bearing bones lose density without countermeasure exercise.

risks.name: Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS)
risks.summary: Optic disc edema and vision changes linked to the headward fluid shift.

risks.name: Adverse behavioral conditions
risks.summary: Isolation, confinement and distance from Earth affect mood, cognition and crew cohesion.

risks.name: Sleep loss and circadian desynchronization
risks.summary: Irregular light and schedules reduce sleep and performance.

risks.name: Altered immune response
risks.summary: Immune dysregulation and latent virus reactivation during flight.

risks.name: Inadequate nutrition
risks.summary: Limited food systems and changed metabolism on long missions.

risks.name: Radiation carcinogenesis and acute effects
risks.summary: Galactic cosmic rays and solar particle events raise long-term cancer risk.
